插件内反馈:GitHub 登录后提交问题或功能愿望。\n *\n * 为什么要求:
In-plugin feedback: sign in with GitHub to report a problem or a feature wish.
 *
 * Why sign-in is required: anonymous tickets cannot be followed up, and there is no way to tell how many times the same complaint appeared.
 * Sign-in only asks for GitHub's read-only identity (read:user), never any repository write permission,
 * and the token is used only to prove to this project's own feedback service "who filed this".
 *
 * The token stays in the local service at all times (see packages/standalone/feedback.mjs),
 * and the page only ever gets the login string — even if a script were injected into the page it could not steal the credentials.
状态读取失败不该挡住表单,登录按钮会再报一次: A failed status read should not block the form; the sign-in button will report it again
已打开 GitHub 授权页。输入下面的验证码后回到这里。: The GitHub authorization page is open. Enter the code below, then come back here.
已登录 GitHub,可以提交反馈了。: Signed in to GitHub. You can submit feedback now.
验证码已过期,请重新发起登录。: The code expired. Please start the sign-in again.
反馈登录已失效,请重新用 GitHub 登录后再次提交（正文已保留）。: Your feedback login expired. Sign in with GitHub again and resubmit (your text has been kept).
报告问题,或告诉我们你想要什么: Report a problem, or tell us what you want
在 GitHub 页面输入这串验证码: Enter this code on the GitHub page
登录只用于确认这条反馈来自谁,方便我们在修好后回来找你。只索取 GitHub 的: Signing in only confirms who sent this feedback, so we can come back and find you once it is fixed. It only requests your public GitHub identity, asks for no repository permissions, and does not publish to a public issue list.
一句话说明出了什么问题: Describe the problem in one sentence
一句话说明你希望有什么: Describe what you want in one sentence
复现步骤、你期望的结果、实际发生了什么。有报错原文请一并贴上。: Steps to reproduce, what you expected, and what actually happened. Paste the original error text if you have it.
你现在的做法是什么、卡在哪里、希望这个功能怎么用。: What you do now, where you get stuck, and how you would like this feature to work.
